Benchmark.title: OCM container image checks supplementing the GPOS SRG profile
Benchmark.description: Checks GPOS SRG requirements against OCM's images: an entrypoint built against the Go Cryptographic Module, a CA bundle, and only the further executables and shared libraries declared for the image.

Profile.title: OCM GPOS SRG supplement
Profile.description: All OCM supplementary checks, for a static image.

Value.title: Allowed executables
Value.description: Anchored regular expression matching the paths of the executables the image may contain: its entrypoint, for example /ocm or /manager, and any declared for the image.

Value.title: Expected CA bundle digest
Value.description: sha256 of the CA bundle in the digest-pinned base image.

Value.title: GOFIPS140 build setting
Value.description: Value of the GOFIPS140 build setting in the entrypoint's Go build information.

Value.title: DefaultGODEBUG build setting
Value.description: Value of the DefaultGODEBUG build setting in the entrypoint's Go build information.

Rule.title: Cryptography runs in a FIPS-validated module
Rule.description: The entrypoint is built with GOFIPS140=v<version> and defaults to fips140=on, so all of OCM's own cryptography runs in the Go Cryptographic Module (CMVP certificate #5247 for v1.0.0). Further executables declared for an image, such as cosign and GnuPG in the default CLI image, are not covered by this check.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203649, SV-203739, SV-203750, SV-203751 and SV-203776, which the Chainguard profile checks for an OpenSSL FIPS provider.

Rule.title: Only approved trust anchors are installed
Rule.description: The only certificate file is /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, and it is byte-identical to the CA bundle of the digest-pinned Garden Linux FIPS base image.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-263659, which the Chainguard profile checks against Wolfi's build-time CA bundle digests.

Rule.title: No package manager, setuid/setgid files, or undeclared executables
Rule.description: The image contains no package manager or package database, no setuid/setgid files, no world-writable file, no world-writable directory without the sticky bit, and no executable other than its entrypoint and the executables declared for it. Shared libraries are checked by ocm_rule_no_shared_libraries or ocm_rule_shared_library_permissions.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203716 (user installation of software): with no package manager, no setuid/setgid files and a non-root user, software cannot be installed.

Rule.title: No shared libraries or dynamic loader
Rule.description: The image contains no shared libraries and no dynamic loader. Selected for images whose executables are all statically linked.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203675 (library permissions): a static image has no library files whose permissions could allow modification.

Rule.title: Shared libraries are owned by root and not writable by group or others
Rule.description: Every shared library and dynamic loader in the image is owned by root and is not writable by its group or by others. Selected for images that ship shared libraries.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203675 (library permissions) for images with dynamically linked executables.

Rule.title: No audit or log data is stored in the image
Rule.description: The image has no /var/log and no log files. OCM writes logs and error messages to stdout/stderr, which the container runtime collects and protects.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203616, SV-203617 (protect audit information) and SV-203664 (error messages only to authorized users), which the Chainguard profile checks through /var/log permissions.
